cases.lockingAndRecoveryConclusion: Actual pinned mechanism is a dedicated PostgreSQL session advisory lock, not Redis. There is no TTL takeover problem for a merely paused worker. Connection loss still releases exclusion while independent sales writes may commit. Retry-before-reevaluation handles ordinary process crash, but busy explicit-ID conversion and postcommit dispatch failure are separate uncovered outcomes.
